title: Mike Vrabel: Ref flagged me because he was sensitive when I told him he made a bad call

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Mike Vrabel: Ref flagged me because he was sensitive when I told him he made a bad call
sources.description: Referee Bill Vinovich said of Vrabel after the game, "He was out of the box, came up to the official and said, 'That was a f-----g terrible call."
